questions.q: The doctor suggested that he ___ more exercise.
questions.why: Після *suggest that* у формальній англійській — базова форма для всіх осіб (subjunctive): *that he take*, без *-s*. *to take* і *taking* не стоять після *that*.

questions.q: It's essential that everyone ___ on time.
questions.why: *It's essential that* + базова форма: *everyone arrive* (без *-s*).

questions.q: They insisted that she ___ present.
questions.why: *insist that* + *be* для будь-якої особи: *that she be present*.

questions.q: We recommend that you ___ this app.
questions.why: Заперечення в subjunctive — *not* + базова форма, без *do*: *that you not use*.

questions.q: I suggest ___ a break.
questions.why: Після *suggest* можна й *-ing*: *I suggest taking a break.*

questions.q: If I ___ you, I'd accept the offer.
questions.why: Past subjunctive — *were* для всіх осіб: *If I were you…*

questions.q: The court ordered that the company ___ a fine.
questions.why: *order that* + базова форма: *that the company pay*.

questions.q: It is important that he ___ late.
questions.why: Заперечення: *that he not be late*.

questions.q: BrE alternative: I suggest that he ___ see a doctor.
questions.why: Британці часто кажуть *should* + дієслово: *I suggest that he should see a doctor.*

questions.q: The manager demanded that the report ___ (be) finished today.
questions.why: *demand that* + *be* (або *should be*).

questions.q: I propose that we ___ (start) now.
questions.why: *propose that we start* (або *should start*).

questions.q: It's vital that she ___ (not / miss) the deadline.
questions.why: *that she not miss* (або *should not miss*).

questions.q: He requested that the meeting ___ (postpone).
questions.why: Пасив у subjunctive — *be* + третя форма: *that the meeting be postponed*.

questions.q: ___ that as it may, we have to decide.
questions.why: *Be that as it may* — сталий вираз «хай там як».

questions.q: Come what ___, I'll support you.
questions.why: *Come what may* — «хоч би що сталося».

answer: I suggest that he see a doctor
questions.why: *I suggest that he see a doctor* — без *-s*.
questions.hint: Пропоную, щоб він звернувся до лікаря.

answer: It is essential that she be there
questions.why: *It is essential that she be there* — *be* для будь-якої особи.
*insisted that we stay* — базова форма.

questions.q: The doctor recommended that he ___ more exercise.
questions.why: *recommended that he take* — базова форма.

questions.q: If need ___, we can stay late.
questions.why: *if need be* — «якщо буде потрібно».

questions.q: It's essential that everyone ___ (be) on time.
questions.why: Після *essential that* — *be* (американський стиль) або *should be* (британський).

questions.q: If the factory ___ close, many people would lose their jobs. (дуже малоймовірно)
questions.why: *were to* + дієслово — дуже малоймовірна, уявна подія в майбутньому.

questions.q: ___ it not for your help, I would be lost.
questions.why: *Were it not for…* — «якби не…» про теперішнє. *Was* в інверсії не вживають.

questions.q: Had it not ___ for the rain, we would have won.
questions.why: *Had it not been for…* — «якби не…» про минуле.
